cases.rationale: Prospective full-reference barium off-stoichiometry transfer case. Major R-3c Ba3W2O9, residual BaCO3 and compensating WO3 preserve the robotically dosed Ba:W = 1:1 ratio. The exact published references remain available. This tests whether an unfamiliar cation-rich product is recognized without a missing-library confound, while a weak residual carbonate is retained through a three-phase heavy-atom refinement.
